resetEnv: Stored settings removed. Environment variables now apply.
resetOff: Stored settings removed. SMTP is not configured.
storageHint: Saved on the server ({path}) and applied without a restart. Without an SMTP host, messages stay in the local outbox.
serverError: Could not read server status: {error}. Is the API server running?
dirty: Unsaved changes. Save the settings before testing your changes.
testHint: Connects and authenticates without sending a message.
notConfigured: Not configured — file mode, no actual emails
deliveredTo: Message delivered to {to}. If it does not arrive, check the spam folder.
connectionOk: Connected to the SMTP server at {host}:{port}.
authError: Authentication failed. Check the account and, if required, its app password.
hostError: SMTP host unreachable. Check the address and port.
timeoutError: Connection timed out. Check the SMTP port and encryption mode.
socketError: Connection refused or interrupted. Check the port and TLS mode.
tlsError: Encryption failed. Check TLS mode and the server certificate.
messageError: Message rejected. Check whether the account permits this sender address.
